How to Download Railway NTPC Score Card 2026?

Candidate should now download the NTPC Scorecard from the official RRB websites as per the steps that we have provided below.

  1. First of all visit the official Railway Recruitment Board website.
  2. Then click on the link titled “RRB NTPC Scorecard 2026” available on the homepage.
  3. After that enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth in the window.
  4. Then fill in the captcha code and click on the Login button.
  5. Finally, your RRB NTPC Scorecard will appear on the screen.
  6. Then you can check your marks, normalized score, and qualifying status carefully.

What After RRB NTPC Scorecard 2026?

Now the RRB NTPC Scorecard 2026 has been released, so first you have to check whether you have qualified for the 2nd Stage CBT or not. Those who are shortlisted have to start preparing for the next examination stage that is CBT 2 Examination as competition will be tough. Candidates should also keep their documents ready for future verification rounds. Candidates are advised to keep visiting the official RRB website for the latest updates on CBT 2 exam date, admit card and further selection process.

RRB NTPC Graduate CBT 2 Exam Date 2026

After the announcement of RRB NTPC CBT 1 Result, the Railway Recruitment Board has announced the RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT 2 Exam Date now. The RRB NTPC CBT 2 Exam for Graduate level will be held on 10th July 2026. Candidates who qualified in CBT 1 will be eligible to appear for this stage. The exact exam dates, city intimation slip and admit card details will be released on the official RRB websites. Students are advised to check the official website for regularly updates.

RRB NTPC Scorecard 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is RRB NTPC Scorecard 2026 released?
Ans. Yes, the RRB NTPC Scorecard has been released on 12th June 2026.

Q2. How can I download the Railway NTPC Scorecard 2026?
Ans. You can now download Railway NTPC Scorecard 2026 by login with your Registration Number and Date of Birth.

Q3. What details are available on the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Scorecard 2026?
Ans. The scorecard has raw marks, normalized marks, questions attempted and qualifying status.

Q4. Who can check the NTPC Scorecard 2026?
Ans. All candidates who have appeared for the RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT 1 exam conducted from 16th to 27th March can check their scorecards.

Q5. What is the next stage after the RRB NTPC 2026 Scorecard?
Ans. Candidates who qualify in CBT 1 will be called for the RRB NTPC CBT 2 examination, that will be conducted on 10th July 2026.

Q6. What is the qualifying status in the RRB NTPC Scorecard 2026?

Ans. The qualifying status in the RRB NTPC Scorecard 2026 indicates whether a candidate has successfully cleared the CBT 1 examination and is eligible to appear for the RRB NTPC CBT 2 Exam 2026. Candidates can check their qualification status along with their raw marks, normalized marks, and shortlist status by downloading the Railway NTPC Scorecard 2026 from the official RRB website.
